dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for coming in today. We will begin once it's our scheduled time.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願い致します。承知致しました。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you. Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。はじめにあなたの年齢、性別をお聞かせ頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for reaching out today. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 18歳、女です
dialogue.English: I'm 18 years old, and female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: なんかもう限界で、どうしたらいいか分かりません
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm at my limit, and I don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: もう限界と思われているのですね。お話しできる範囲で大丈夫なので、もう少し詳しくお聞きしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: So you feel like you're at your limit. It's okay to only share what you're comfortable with, but could you tell me a little more about that?

dialogue.content: 毎日毎日親からいろいろ言われて、もうなんか最近気持ちがどうしようもなくつらくて、自傷行為したくなるんです
dialogue.English: Every single day, my parents say all sorts of things to me, and lately, it's become so unbearably painful that I get the urge to self-harm.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねいろいろ言われ、気持ちが収まらなくなり自分を傷つけたくなってしまうんですね。それは、お辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So when they say these things, your feelings become overwhelming, and you feel the urge to hurt yourself. That must be so painful for you.

dialogue.content: 親からはどのような言葉を言われて、辛くなりますか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things do your parents say that are particularly painful for you?

dialogue.content: 成績が上がらないんだから寝る間があるなら勉強しろとか、もっと家のことをやれとか
dialogue.English: Things like, 'Since your grades aren't improving, you should study instead of sleeping,' and 'You need to do more around the house.'

dialogue.content: 妹も嘘ついて私が変なことしたとか親に告げ口して、それで怒られる
dialogue.English: My younger sister also lies and tattles on me to my parents, saying I did something wrong, and then I get yelled at for it.

dialogue.content: 説明しても言い訳するなと怒鳴られる
dialogue.English: Even when I try to explain, they just shout, 'Don't make excuses!'

dialogue.content: リビングで少しでもくつろごうものならダラダラするなって追い出される
dialogue.English: If I even try to relax a little in the living room, they tell me not to laze around and kick me out.

dialogue.content: もうげんかい
dialogue.English: I'm at my limit.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか、いつも自分が不利な状況に置かれ、言い分もしっかり聞いてもらえず、自宅でもゆっくりとする事も難しい状態で、苦しいんですね。安らぐ場所が無くて悲しいですね。
dialogue.English: I see, I see... you're always put in a difficult position, they don't listen to your side of the story, and it's even hard to relax in your own home. That must be so difficult. It's sad that you have no place to feel at ease.

dialogue.content: 言い返すと何十倍にも返ってくる
dialogue.English: If I talk back, it comes back at me many times worse.

dialogue.content: だからもう何も言わないようにした
dialogue.English: So I've learned to just not say anything anymore.

dialogue.content: 殴られたからやり返してもボコボコにやられたし
dialogue.English: I was hit, so I tried to hit back, but I just got beaten up badly.

dialogue.content: もう自分は家族にとっては邪魔な存在なんですよ
dialogue.English: I'm just a burden to my family now.

dialogue.content: うんうん、自分なりに考えて、伝えようと頑張っていたんだね。伝わらないなら伝えても仕方が無いと思ってしまってるんだね。殴られたの、誰に？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. You were trying so hard, in your own way, to think things through and communicate. And now you've come to feel there’s no point in speaking up if you won't be understood. Who was it that hit you?

dialogue.content: 母親
dialogue.English: My mother.

dialogue.content: お母さん‥なんですね。ケガはしなかった？大丈夫ですか？頻繁に叩かれるの？
dialogue.English: Your mother... I see. Were you injured? Are you okay? Does she hit you often?

dialogue.content: あざぐらいは出来た。でも向こうもそれくらいの怪我してた。頻繁にはない。
dialogue.English: I got some bruises. But she got hurt about the same amount. It doesn't happen often.

dialogue.content: ひどかったのはその時だけ
dialogue.English: It was only really bad that one time.

dialogue.content: そっか、ケガがひどく無くて安心しました。自分が必要ないと感じたときはその、叩かれたときかな？
dialogue.English: I see, I'm relieved your injuries weren't severe. Was it when you were hit that time that you started to feel unwanted?

dialogue.content: いや、その時ではない
dialogue.English: No, it wasn't then.

dialogue.content: 普段から邪魔にされる様なことばっかりだから
dialogue.English: It's because I'm always being treated like a nuisance.

dialogue.content: なんでか妹ばかり可愛がられて私は邪魔
dialogue.English: For some reason, they only dote on my sister, and I’m just a nuisance.

dialogue.content: そうなですねそんな事が、続くと妹だけ可愛いんだと、思ってしまうよね。この状態は、いつ頃からなのかな？きっかけは覚えていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When that sort of thing keeps happening, it's natural to start feeling that they only care about your sister. How long has this been going on? Do you remember what might have started it?

dialogue.content: いつ頃からかははっきりよく分からない。前からこんな感じだったと思うけど、私が高校生になってから激しくなった気がする。きっかけなんかもわからない。
dialogue.English: I'm not exactly sure when it started. I think it was always kind of like this, but it feels like it got worse after I started high school. I don't know what the trigger was, either.

dialogue.content: しかも進路まで口出してきて、私はそれになりたくないんだけど仕方なく目指してる。
dialogue.English: On top of that, they're interfering with my future career path. I don't want to do it, but I feel like I have no choice but to aim for it.

dialogue.content: もうどうしたらいいと思いますか？このまま耐えられる気がしない
dialogue.English: What do you think I should do? I don't feel like I can endure this any longer.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねだから成績の事をしてきされているのですね。お母さんの、縛りがキツくて耐えられない気持ちで、自分を傷つけたくなるんですね。はい、安心してください。しっかりと寄り添いどうしたら不安や怒りや悲しみをコントロール出来るように、なるのか一緒に考えて行きたいと思っておりますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's why they criticize your grades. The pressure from your mother is so intense that you feel you can't bear it, which makes you want to hurt yourself. Yes, please rest assured. I would like to support you and think together about how you can learn to manage these feelings of anxiety, anger, and sadness. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こちらこそお願いいたします。一人で抱えてないで、ちゃんと大人に相談しようって、よく判断出来たね。話してくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you, I look forward to working with you. You made a very good decision to talk to an adult instead of holding it all in. Thank you for sharing this with me.

dialogue.content: 最近、自分を傷つけた事はありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you harmed yourself recently?

dialogue.content: 我慢してる
dialogue.English: I've been resisting the urge.

dialogue.content: そっか、我慢するのも辛いね。どんな思いがあったときに、我慢するのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. It must be hard to resist that urge, too. What kind of feelings are you having when you feel the need to resist?

dialogue.content: ん？自傷したくないから我慢してる
dialogue.English: Hmm? I'm resisting because I don't want to self-harm.

dialogue.content: 分かりづらい、質問でしたね。すいません。どんな感情が強くて自分を自傷する気持ちが強いのか知りたくてしつもんしましたが答えなくでも大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: That was a confusing question, wasn't it? I'm sorry. I was trying to ask what strong emotions lead to the intense urge to self-harm, but you don't have to answer if you don't want to.

dialogue.content: したくなる時どんな気持ちかはよく分からない。なんか悔しいやら悲しいやらぐちゃぐちゃした気持ち。
dialogue.English: I’m not really sure what I feel when I want to do it. It’s a messy, jumbled-up feeling of frustration and sadness.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとうございます。いろんな、感情が入り交じって苦しくなるのですね。その感情は、自分を守るための防衛反応で自然なことです。安心してくださいね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me. So various emotions get mixed up and it becomes painful. Those feelings are a natural defense mechanism to protect yourself. Please know that's okay.

dialogue.content: や、でもきついのはきつい
dialogue.English: Yeah, but it’s still really hard.

dialogue.content: うんうん、分かってほしいのに分かってももらえないのは、きついですよね。ぐちゃぐちゃなままにしないようにして行けたらと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm. It's so hard when you want to be understood but you aren't. I was hoping we could work on not leaving those feelings all jumbled up. How would you feel about that?

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, that sounds good.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ぐちゃぐちゃの中の、悔しさと悲しさどちらも感じたときにしっかりと自分を自分で抱きしめてあげてほしいです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. When you feel both that frustration and sadness inside that jumbled mess, I'd like you to try to give yourself a big hug.

dialogue.content: それでなにか変化があるんですか？
dialogue.English: Will that make any difference?

dialogue.content: ロールプレイありがとうございました。時間までにしっかりと終了できなくて失礼いたしました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for the role-play. I apologize that we couldn't finish properly before our time was up.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much. Thank you for your time and effort.

dialogue.content: 貴重なお時間ありがとうございました。終了させていただきますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your valuable time. We'll end the session here.

dialogue.content: はい、失礼します。
dialogue.English: Okay, goodbye.
